newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebels say towns captured on way to Kinshasa.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels say towns captured on way to Kinshasa.

text.p: Zaire's rebel forces have captured the towns of Ilebo, Tshikapa and Bowete and are closing in on the capital Kinshasa, a senior official of the rebel alliance said on Wednesday.

"We can announce tonight the capture of Bowete, Tshikapa and Ilebo," rebel "justice minister" Mwenge Kongolo told a news conference. "We are also approaching Kikwit and our progress is going on normally."

Asked if rebel forces planned to attack Kinshasa from the southwest, entering Zaire from Angolan territory, the official said: "The Angolans are our friends, that's for sure. But our troops are not in Angola."
He said he believed the fall of Kinshasa was a "matter of days rather than weeks" and added that in his personal opinion there would not be a bloody battle for the capital.
Laurent kabila's rebel Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire paraded a general and five colonels of the defeated Zaire army in Lubumbashi on Wednesday.
A general called Molambo said the AFDL forces were militarily very strong and appealed to some of his men still hiding in the bush or in the city itself to give themselves up without fear of abuse.
